A Higher Low pattern is forming, with the 5-day low ($875.24) exceeding the 20-day low ($868.25), supporting recovery. The current price ($946.22) is 4.76% above the SMA200 ($903.19) and has settled above the SMA5 ($923.88) and SMA20 ($929.41). The weekly ADX of 28.7 indicates a clear trend.
